'''Atheloe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the day that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] chartered [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] for passage to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Atheloe had a seat in front of the entrance and close to the bar.<ref name="RG" /><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Atheloe was created as a background character for the cantina scene in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], one of two members of his species to appear in the film. The character was designed by [[John Mollo]],<ref name="SWC ">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and his mask was sculpted by [[Stuart Freeborn]] for shooting in England.<ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The only difference between the two Lutrillian costumes was an ascot worn by one of the actors;<ref name="MOSW ">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> the crew referred to at least one of these characters as the Colonel,<ref name="CRC" /> and at least one as the Hare Mouse.<ref name="SWC " /> [[Lucasfilm]]'s personnel dubbed one of the characters as [[Ownellco/Legends|Ownellco]] when [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] asked for official names for the cantina denizens. The article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]" conflates these two Lutrillians as the same, leaving it unclear which Lutrillian was due to be named Ownellco.<ref name="CRC" /> However, the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Unusual Suspects: Who's Who in Mos Eisley]]" establishes that the ascot-wearing Lutrillian is Ownellco and gives the name of Atheloe to the seated Lutrillian.<ref name="RG" /> The name "Atheloe" was originally used as an example Lutrillian name in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GATORW ">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

[[File:SolomahalTzizvvt.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Atheloe meets with [[Tzizvvt]]]]
Atheloe is not very visible, and he receives little screen time, only briefly visible sitting near a pillar directly in front of the cantina entrance. One of the Lutrillians is later visible walking the streets of Mos Eisley.<ref name="ANH" /> Atheloe is more prominently featured in a rough cut of the cantina sequence.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.</ref>
